#[cfg(test)]
mod positional_native_tests {
    use super::*;
    use serde_json::{json, Value};

    #[test]
    fn corpus() {
        let normalizer = Normalizer::new().unwrap();
        let cases: Vec<Value> = serde_json::from_str(include_str!(concat!(
            env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"),
            "/cases.json"
        )))
        .unwrap();
        for (index, case) in cases.iter().enumerate() {
            let branch = case["branch"].as_str().unwrap();
            let input = case["input"].as_str().unwrap();
            let result = match case["mode"].as_str() {
                Some("base64") => normalizer.normalize_base64_json(branch, input),
                Some("value") => {
                    normalizer.normalize_value(branch, &serde_json::from_str(input).unwrap())
                }
                _ => normalizer.normalize(branch, input),
            };
            match result {
                Ok(value) => assert_eq!(Some(&value), case.get("value"), "case {index}: {case}"),
                Err(error) => assert_eq!(
                    Some(json!(error.0)),
                    case.get("errors").cloned(),
                    "case {index}: {case}"
                ),
            }
        }
        eprintln!(
            "native Rust positional corpus executed {} cases",
            cases.len()
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn full_arity_is_checked_independently_of_the_selected_index() {
        let pointer = "/defensive/position";
        let expected = json!([{"pointer":pointer,"rule":"position_value","detail":"position encountered a value outside its checked tuple contract"}]);
        for (arity, value, index) in [
            (None, json!(["a", "b"]), 0),
            (Some(0), json!(["a", "b"]), 0),
            (Some(2), json!(["a"]), 0),
            (Some(2), json!(["a", "b", "excess"]), 0),
            (Some(2), json!({}), 0),
            (Some(2), json!(["a", "b"]), 2),
            (Some(2), json!(["a", "b"]), u64::MAX),
        ] {
            let position_arities = arity
                .map(|arity| (pointer.to_owned(), arity))
                .into_iter()
                .collect();
            let context = eval::Context {
                input: &value,
                item: None,
                index: None,
                binary64: true,
                position_arities: &position_arities,
            };
            let expression: recipe::Expr = serde_json::from_value(json!({"op":"position","index":index,"value":{"op":"read","scope":"input","path":[]}})).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(
                json!(context.value(&expression, pointer).unwrap_err().0),
                expected
            );
        }
    }
}
